room_pre.caption: Delivery for you. One hive, slightly used. Sign here.
room_pre.spoken_text: Delivery for you. One hive, slightly used. Sign here.

room_pre_nudge.caption: Poke it with one finger. That's how you'll pick everything today.
room_pre_nudge.spoken_text: Poke it with one finger. That's how you'll pick everything today.

room_hook_carry.caption: Easy! Easy! I'd help, but drones don't carry. No pollen baskets. It's in the contract.
room_hook_carry.spoken_text: Easy! Easy! I'd help, but drones don't carry. No pollen baskets. It's in the contract.

room_hook_1.caption: Save our hive, or the swarms take Earth. That rocket is our backup plan.
room_hook_1.spoken_text: Save our hive, or the swarms take Earth. That rocket is our backup plan.

room_hook_2.caption: Your evacuation rocket. Honeymoon One. We booked you a window seat.
room_hook_2.spoken_text: Your evacuation rocket. Honeymoon One. We booked you a window seat.

room_meet_1.caption: Beeswax, like the candle. Shop steward, Local Twenty Thousand. One union, twenty thousand kinds of bee.
room_meet_1.spoken_text: Beeswax, like the candle. Shop steward, Local Twenty Thousand. One union, twenty thousand kinds of bee.

room_meet_role.caption: My hive's sick. The beekeeper quit. You signed. Congratulations, beekeeper.
room_meet_role.spoken_text: My hive's sick. Beekeeper quit. You signed. Congratulations, beekeeper.

room_meet_hey_beeswax.caption: When you see Ask Beeswax, hold the mic and say, “Hey Beeswax,” then ask your question.
room_meet_hey_beeswax.spoken_text: When you see Ask Beeswax, hold the mic and say, “Hey Beeswax,” then ask your question.

room_forecast.caption: Job perk: that window shows the future. Paris, tomorrow. Lovely.
room_forecast.spoken_text: Job perk: that window shows the future. Paris, tomorrow. Bee-utiful.

room_meet_2.caption: Four problems. Four minutes. Or you're on that rocket.
room_meet_2.spoken_text: Four problems. Four minutes. Or you're on that rocket.

room_meet_stat.caption: In one recent year, American beekeepers lost more than half their hives. Somebody has to speak up.
room_meet_stat.spoken_text: In one recent year, American beekeepers lost more than half their hives. Somebody has to be loud.

room_smoker_intro.caption: Problem one: the girls are buzzing mad. Help calm them. Pick one.
room_smoker_intro.spoken_text: Problem one: the girls are buzzing mad. Calm them down. Pick one.

room_hint_smoker.caption: Off the record? Beekeepers don't swat. They puff.
room_hint_smoker.spoken_text: Off the record? Beekeepers don't swat. They puff.

room_smoker_swat.caption: Ooh, a swat! Squish one bee and her alarm smell will call the whole shift. That's why beekeepers never swat. They puff smoke.
room_smoker_swat.spoken_text: You swatted a union member?! Squish one bee and her alarm smell calls the whole shift.

room_smoker_spray_water.caption: Water just makes them wet and grumpy. Smoke is what works, because it covers the alarm smell they use to call for help.
room_smoker_spray_water.spoken_text: Water? Now they're wet and still buzzing mad. Smoke masks the alarm smell.

room_smoker_smoker.caption: Ahh, much better. Smoke covers our alarm smell, so nobody calls for backup, and we fill up on honey. Fun fact: that alarm smells like bananas.
room_smoker_smoker.spoken_text: Ahh. Smoke covers our alarm smell and makes us fill up on honey. The alarm? Smells like bananas.

room_smoker_hand.caption: They're calm. These bees are virtual, so hold out your hand. Real ones? Bee-hold, but don't touch.
room_smoker_hand.spoken_text: They're calm. Hold out your hand. These ones are virtual. Real ones? Bee-hold, but don't touch.

room_feed_intro.caption: Problem two. Speaking of honey, is any left? Now lift the hive.
room_feed_intro.spoken_text: Problem two. Speaking of honey, any left? Now lift the hive.

room_lift_light.caption: Light? A full hive is heavy with honey. The movers were being dramatic.
room_lift_light.spoken_text: Light, right? That's bad. Full hives are heavy with honey. The movers were being dramatic.

room_feed_rocket_fuel.caption: Where'd the honey go? ...Your rocket. Somebody had to fuel it.
room_feed_rocket_fuel.spoken_text: Where'd the honey go? , Your rocket. Somebody had to fuel it.

room_feed_prompt.caption: So feed us. Store-bought honey, or sugar syrup?
room_feed_prompt.spoken_text: So feed us. Store-bought honey, or sugar syrup?

room_hint_feed.caption: Off the record? You don't know where store honey's been.
room_hint_feed.spoken_text: Off the record? You don't know where store honey's been.

room_feed_store_honey.caption: Store honey can carry foulbrood, a disease that kills baby bees, and its spores last for decades. Fine on toast, deadly in a hive.
room_feed_store_honey.spoken_text: , Honey. From a store. It can carry foulbrood. Its spores last decades. Fine on toast, deadly in a hive.

room_feed_sugar_syrup.caption: Sugar syrup, sweet choice. Beekeepers lift the hive to feel how much honey is inside. A light hive is a hungry hive, so syrup it is.
room_feed_sugar_syrup.spoken_text: Sugar syrup. Sweet. Beekeepers lift the hive to check for food, then feed syrup.

room_feed_why.caption: Why avoid store honey? It can carry foulbrood spores. Fine on toast, deadly in a hive.
room_feed_why.spoken_text: Why avoid store honey? It can carry foulbrood spores. Fine on toast, deadly in a hive.

room_wasps_arrive.caption: Bees feed their young pollen. Many wasps bring bugs. These wasps want our syrup.
room_wasps_arrive.spoken_text: Bees feed their young pollen. Many wasps bring bugs. These want syrup.

room_wasps_batoff.caption: Guard duty! Bounce 'em, don't squish 'em. A squished wasp's alarm scent will call in her nestmates.
room_wasps_batoff.spoken_text: Guard duty! Bounce 'em, don't squish 'em. A squished wasp's alarm scent calls in her nestmates.

room_wasps_batoff_nice.caption: Look at you, bouncing. Real guard bees check everyone at the door and shove intruders out.
room_wasps_batoff_nice.spoken_text: Look at you, bouncing. Real guard bees check everyone at the door and shove intruders out.

room_wasps_batoff_door.caption: One made it to the door! Guards are on her. Shoving's in the job description.
room_wasps_batoff_door.spoken_text: One made it to the door! Guards are on her. Shoving's in the job description.

room_wasps_batoff_done.caption: Shift's over. Zero squished, zero alarm smell. Overtime's bee-yond my pay grade.
room_wasps_batoff_done.spoken_text: Shift's over. Zero squished, zero alarm smell. Overtime's bee-yond my pay grade.

room_wasps_intro.caption: Nobody ordered wasps. We're short on guards. Make the door bigger, or smaller?
room_wasps_intro.spoken_text: Nobody ordered wasps. We're short on guards. Make the door bigger, or smaller?

room_hint_wasps.caption: Off the record? Think castle. Big gate or small gate?
room_hint_wasps.spoken_text: Off the record? Think castle. Big gate or small gate?

room_wasps_bigger_door.caption: Bigger?! You built the wasps a drive-through. A bigger door needs more guard bees to defend it. Grievance filed.
room_wasps_bigger_door.spoken_text: Bigger?! You built the wasps a drive-through. More door takes more guards. Grievance filed.

room_wasps_smaller_door.caption: That's an entrance reducer. With a smaller door, fewer guards can hold it, so the wasps give up. Buzz off, wasps.
room_wasps_smaller_door.spoken_text: That's an entrance reducer. Smaller door, fewer guards needed to hold it. Buzz off, wasps.

room_hornet_1.caption: Giant hornet! My cousins in Japan cook these. Never tried it. Make a FIST!
room_hornet_1.spoken_text: giant hornet! My cousins in Japan cook these. Never tried it. Make a fist!

room_hornet_3.caption: In Japan, over five hundred bees can cook a hornet at about forty-six degrees Celsius. We're winging it. Louder!
room_hornet_3.spoken_text: Louder! In Japan it takes over five hundred bees and about forty-six degrees Celsius. We're winging it. louder!

room_heat_intro.caption: Last problem: heat wave. The babies are getting hot. Pick a water dish.
room_heat_intro.spoken_text: Last problem: heat wave. The babies are cooking. Pick a water dish.

room_hint_heat.caption: Off the record? Bees can't swim. Where would a bee stand to drink?
room_hint_heat.spoken_text: Off the record? Bees can't swim. Where would a bee stand to drink?

room_heat_deep_bowl.caption: A deep bowl? Bees can't swim, so they'd drown trying to drink, and the lifeguard's on strike. Grievance filed.
room_heat_deep_bowl.spoken_text: A deep bowl? That's a pool. Bees drown in deep water, and the lifeguard's on strike. Grievance filed.

room_heat_nothing.caption: Nothing? In a heat wave? Bees cool the hive with water, so without it the babies overheat. Grievance filed.
room_heat_nothing.spoken_text: Nothing? In a heat wave? We cool the hive with water. No water, no air conditioning. Grievance filed. Angrily.

room_heat_pebble_dish.caption: Pebbles! Now we have somewhere to land and drink. Back home we spread the water drops around and fan our wings. Bee air conditioning.
room_heat_pebble_dish.spoken_text: Pebbles! Somewhere to land. We spread water drops in the hive and fan our wings. Bee air conditioning.

room_whatif_prompt.caption: Four for four! Now you drive the window. Pinch, hold, and ask me "what if."
room_whatif_prompt.spoken_text: Four for four! Now you drive the window. Pinch, hold, and ask me "what if."

room_whatif_notfire.caption: Rain, flowers, anything. Just not fire.
room_whatif_notfire.spoken_text: Rain, flowers, anything. Just not fire.

room_hint_whatif.caption: Try asking about a fire. ...Actually, don't.
room_hint_whatif.spoken_text: Try asking about a fire. , Actually, don't.

room_whatif_fire.caption: Don't. Say. That. ...You said it. Watch the window. I can't look.
room_whatif_fire.spoken_text: Don't say that. , You said it. Watch the window. I can't look.

room_whatif_fire_2.caption: Don't. Say. That. ...Again?! You get your own spreadsheet. Watch the window.
room_whatif_fire_2.spoken_text: Don't say that. , Again?! You get your own spreadsheet. Watch the window.

room_whatif_fire_3.caption: Don't. Say. That. ...Why does everybody say that? Watch the window.
room_whatif_fire_3.spoken_text: Don't say that. , Why does everybody say that? Watch the window.

room_whatif_putout.caption: It's spreading! Pinch and say "put it out". Tell the window what you want.
room_whatif_putout.spoken_text: It's spreading! Pinch and say "put it out"! say IT!

room_whatif_out.caption: Fire brigade! ...It's out. Bees don't fight fires. We help burned land grow back.
room_whatif_out.spoken_text: Fire brigade! , It's out. Bees don't fight fires. We help burned land grow back.

room_whatif_out_2.caption: It's out. I'm putting "no fire" in the bylaws. In bold.
room_whatif_out_2.spoken_text: It's out. I'm putting "no fire" in the bylaws. In bold.

room_whatif_out_3.caption: Fire's out. I'm not crying, that's smoke. Motion carried.
room_whatif_out_3.spoken_text: Fire's out. I'm not crying, that's smoke. Motion carried.

room_whatif_rain.caption: Rain? Fine. Hardly anybee forages in the rain. We'll stay in and do paperwork.
room_whatif_rain.spoken_text: Rain? Fine. Hardly anybee forages in the rain. We'll stay in and do paperwork.

room_whatif_flowers.caption: Flowers? Now you're talking. More flowers, more food. I don't forage, but I'll allow it.
room_whatif_flowers.spoken_text: Flowers? Now you're talking. More flowers, more food. I don't forage, but I'll allow it.

room_whatif_spray.caption: Pesticide? It drifts onto the flowers, and we carry it home to the babies. Grievance filed. Twice.
room_whatif_spray.spoken_text: Pesticide? It drifts onto the flowers, and we carry it home to the babies. Grievance filed. Twice.

room_whatif_winter.caption: Winter? The girls huddle around the queen and shiver to keep her warm. Drones get kicked out. Grievance pending.
room_whatif_winter.spoken_text: Winter? The girls huddle around the queen and shiver to keep her warm. Drones get kicked out. Grievance pending.

room_whatif_custom.caption: Hold on. I'm picturing it. ...Okay. Watch the window.
room_whatif_custom.spoken_text: Hold on. I'm picturing it. , Okay. Watch the window.

room_whatif_custom_2.caption: Not on the agenda. ...I'll allow it. Picturing it now.
room_whatif_custom_2.spoken_text: Not on the agenda. , I'll allow it. Picturing it now.

room_whatif_custom_3.caption: New motion. Let me picture it. Don't rush me. Union rules.
room_whatif_custom_3.spoken_text: New motion. Let me picture it. Don't rush me. Union rules.

room_whatif_custom_clips.caption: I'm picturing it. The window isn't. It's on its union break. Ask about rain.
room_whatif_custom_clips.spoken_text: I'm picturing it. The window isn't. It's on its union break. Ask about rain.

room_whatif_refuse.caption: Grievance filed. Not that one. Ask something I could show the queen. She's my mom.
room_whatif_refuse.spoken_text: Grievance filed. Not that one. Ask something I could show the queen. She's my mom.

room_whatif_back.caption: Fine. Back to how it was. Like it never happened. It's in the minutes, though.
room_whatif_back.spoken_text: Fine. Back to how it was. Like it never happened. It's in the minutes, though.

room_whatif_nothing.caption: Undo what? Nothing's on fire. Yet.
room_whatif_nothing.spoken_text: Undo what? Nothing's on fire. Yet.

room_adjourn.caption: Motion to adjourn. Seconded, by me. All in favor?
room_adjourn.spoken_text: Motion to adjourn. Seconded, by me. All in favor?

room_live_filler.caption: I could drone on all day. Short version:
room_live_filler.spoken_text: I could drone on all day. Short version:

room_escape.caption: Motion carried. No ravaging today. Cancel the evacuation.
room_escape.spoken_text: Motion carried. No ravaging today. Cancel the evacuation.

room_escape_minutes.caption: For the minutes: smoke, syrup, a small door, and shallow water. That's real beekeeping.
room_escape_minutes.spoken_text: For the minutes: smoke, syrup, small door, shallow water. That's real beekeeping.

room_escape_credit.caption: Thanks, beekeeper. ...Strike that from the minutes.
room_escape_credit.spoken_text: Thanks, beekeeper. , Strike that from the minutes.

room_t0_1.caption: ...Shame to waste a ticket. Non-refundable.
room_t0_1.spoken_text: , Shame to waste a ticket. Non-refundable.

room_t0_earth.caption: Look at Earth. From up here, it barely moves. Just hangs there. Like a drone. I oughta know.
room_t0_earth.spoken_text: Look at Earth. From up here, it barely moves. Just hangs there. Like a drone. I oughta know.

room_t0_3.caption: ...Not one flower. We've only found them on Earth.
room_t0_3.spoken_text: , Not one flower. We've only found them on Earth.

room_t0_4.caption: I'm back. Nobody saw that. Mind your own beeswax.
room_t0_4.spoken_text: I'm back. Nobody saw that. Mind your own beeswax.

room_t0_fake_moon.caption: Turns out the Moon was fake. Union rules say you get it anyway.
room_t0_fake_moon.spoken_text: Turns out the Moon was fake. Union rules say you get it anyway.

room_truth.caption: Truth time. Real swarms are gentle. Real hives die quietly: mites, hunger, heat, poison.
room_truth.spoken_text: Truth time. Real swarms are gentle. Real hives die quietly: mites, hunger, heat, poison.

room_map.caption: Same time tomorrow? Other hives have it worse. Wild bees don't even get a beekeeper.
room_map.spoken_text: Same time tomorrow? Other hives have it worse. Wild bees don't even get a beekeeper.

room_end_contract.caption: You're hired. New contract: plant flowers, skip bug spray, add a pebble dish. Hive five.
room_end_contract.spoken_text: You're hired. New contract: plant flowers, skip bug spray, add a pebble dish. Hive five.

room_ack_order.caption: Point of order. Hive first, questions later.
room_ack_order.spoken_text: Point of order. Hive first, questions later.

room_crew_heavy.caption: Lift with your wings, please. Mine are strictly decorative.

room_fact_festoon.caption: That's festooning. We hook our legs together into chains. Scientists still aren't sure why.
room_fact_festoon.spoken_text: That's festooning. We hook our legs together into chains. Scientists still aren't sure why.

room_strike_lookup.caption: Look up. Bees don't picket. We swarm. Each grievance makes it bigger. Pick again.
room_strike_lookup.spoken_text: Look up. Bees don't picket. We swarm. Every grievance makes it bigger. Pick again.

room_timeout.caption: Overruled. Let's pick together. Watch closely.
room_timeout.spoken_text: Overruled. I'll pick for you. Watch closely.

room_clock_zero.caption: Time's up. ...I'm granting an extension. Union discretion. Keep going.
room_clock_zero.spoken_text: Time's up. , I'm granting an extension. Union discretion. Keep going.

room_canned_unclear.caption: What IS that? Not on the agenda.
room_canned_unclear.spoken_text: What IS that? Not on the agenda.

room_verdict_person.caption: That's a person. I review hives, not people.
room_verdict_person.spoken_text: That's a person. I review hives, not people.

ear_practice.caption: Testing. Is that coffee I smell?

ear_no_signal.caption: I can't reach the hive. Check the hotspot.
ear_no_signal.spoken_text: I can't reach the hive. Check the hotspot.

ear_hold_still.caption: Hold still while I take a look.

ear_hold_still_2.caption: Still reviewing. Union rules. No rushing.
ear_hold_still_2.spoken_text: Still reviewing. Union rules. No rushing.

ear_canned_unclear.caption: What IS that? Not on the agenda.
ear_canned_unclear.spoken_text: What IS that? Not on the agenda.

ear_hint_feed.caption: Psst. Lift the hive first. Then syrup.
ear_hint_feed.spoken_text: Psst. Lift the hive first. Then syrup.

ear_hint_wasps.caption: Psst. A smaller door means fewer guards.

ear_hint_whatif.caption: Ask me: what if a fire starts?
ear_hint_whatif.spoken_text: Ask me: what if a fire starts?

ear_aside_window.caption: That's the meadow window. Your choices show up there.
ear_aside_window.spoken_text: That's the meadow window. Your choices show up there.

ear_aside_hornet.caption: Not all wasps are bad. Just that guy.
ear_aside_hornet.spoken_text: Not all wasps are bad. Just that guy.

room_pal_boop_giggle.caption: Hee! Quit it. I'm on the clock.
room_pal_boop_giggle.spoken_text: Hee! Quit it. I'm on the clock.

room_pal_boop_file.caption: Was that a boop? That's harassment. I'm filing.
room_pal_boop_file.spoken_text: Was that a boop? That's harassment. I'm filing.

room_pal_boop_blush.caption: Okay. One boop. Off the record.
room_pal_boop_blush.spoken_text: Okay. One boop. Off the record.

room_pal_highfive.caption: Up top! I'd go high-six, but you're a finger short.
room_pal_highfive.spoken_text: Up top! I'd go high-six, but you're a finger short.

room_pal_palm.caption: Bee-hold. Foragers away from home rarely sting. Too busy. Real ones? Look, don't touch.
room_pal_palm.spoken_text: Bee-hold. Foragers away from home rarely sting. Too busy. Real ones? Look, don't touch.

room_pal_honey_offer.caption: Bonus shift. Pinch that frame's top bar and pull it out.
room_pal_honey_offer.spoken_text: Bonus shift. Pinch that frame's top bar and pull it out.

room_pal_honey_caps.caption: See the wax lids? Bees cap honey once it's ripe. Scrape them off.
room_pal_honey_caps.spoken_text: See the wax lids? Bees cap honey once it's ripe. Scrape them off.

room_pal_honey_help.caption: Fine, I'll scrape. Drones can't make wax, but taking it off? That I can do.
room_pal_honey_help.spoken_text: Fine, I'll scrape. Drones can't make wax. Taking it off, I can do.

room_pal_honey_winter.caption: That's plenty. The rest stays. They eat it all winter.
room_pal_honey_winter.spoken_text: That's plenty. The rest stays. They eat it all winter.

room_pal_dance.caption: I don't forage, but I took the seminar. The waggle points to food from the sun. Longer waggle, farther flowers.
room_pal_dance.spoken_text: I don't forage, but I took the seminar. The waggle points to food from the sun. Longer waggle, farther flowers.

room_pal_show_me.caption: Motion carried. Eyes on the window.
room_pal_show_me.spoken_text: Motion carried. Eyes on the window.

room_pal_pet.caption: Gentle. They like you. Don't tell them I said that.
room_pal_pet.spoken_text: Gentle. They like you. Don't tell them I said that.

ask_bananas.caption: Our alarm smell shares a chemical with bananas. Smoke drowns it out. Noted for the minutes.
ask_bananas.spoken_text: Our alarm smell shares a chemical with bananas. Smoke drowns it out. Noted for the minutes.

ask_drone_sting.caption: No. A stinger's a modified egg-laying tube, and drones don't lay eggs. All buzz, no sting.
ask_drone_sting.spoken_text: No. A stinger's a modified egg-laying tube, and drones don't lay eggs. All buzz, no sting.

ask_wildfire.caption: We don't stop fires. But wild bees often bounce back after one and pollinate what regrows.
ask_wildfire.spoken_text: We don't stop fires. But wild bees often bounce back after one and pollinate what regrows.

ask_help_most.caption: Wild ones. About four thousand kinds live in the US, with no beekeeper. Plant flowers.
ask_help_most.spoken_text: Wild ones. About four thousand kinds live in the US, with no beekeeper. Plant flowers.

ask_killing.caption: A big one is a mite called varroa. It spreads viruses. Grievance filed.
ask_killing.spoken_text: A big one is a mite called varroa. It spreads viruses. Grievance filed.

ask_sting_help.caption: Stung? Tell a grown-up. Allergic? That's a doctor's job, not a union job.
ask_sting_help.spoken_text: Stung? Tell a grown-up. Allergic? That's a doctor's job, not a union job.

ask_offlist.caption: That's above my drone pay grade. Ask me about smoke, syrup, doors, water or wild bees.
ask_offlist.spoken_text: That's above my drone pay grade. Ask me about smoke, syrup, doors, water or wild bees.

ask_people.caption: I rate hives, not people. Back to work.
ask_people.spoken_text: I rate hives, not people. Back to work.

ask_stall.caption: My spreadsheet froze. Ask me again. Union pace.
ask_stall.spoken_text: My spreadsheet froze. Ask me again. Union pace.

ask_not_heard.caption: Didn't catch that. Hold the pinch the whole time you talk.
ask_not_heard.spoken_text: Didn't catch that. Hold the pinch the whole time you talk.

ask_offline.caption: I can't reach the hive. Poke a question on the card.
ask_offline.spoken_text: I can't reach the hive. Poke a question on the card.

room_feed_lift_hint.caption: Grab the hive and rock it back and forth. Feel how heavy it is.
room_feed_lift_hint.spoken_text: Grab the hive and rock it back and forth. Feel how heavy it is.

room_feed_rock_retry.caption: Hold on. Pick it back up and give it a rock. We still need to feel how heavy it is.
room_feed_rock_retry.spoken_text: Hold on. Pick it back up and give it a rock. We still need to feel how heavy it is.

room_heat_pebble_toss.caption: Toss in more pebbles. Bees can't swim. They drink standing up, like at a bar.
room_heat_pebble_toss.spoken_text: Toss in more pebbles. Bees can't swim. They drink standing up, like at a bar.

room_heat_pebble_cheer.caption: Bar's open. First round's on the hive.
room_heat_pebble_cheer.spoken_text: Bar's open. First round's on the hive.

room_wasps_stinger.caption: I wasn't hiding. Drones can't sting. A stinger's a modified egg-laying tube. Girls only.
room_wasps_stinger.spoken_text: I wasn't hiding. Drones can't sting. A stinger's a modified egg-laying tube. Girls only.

room_heat_mom.caption: The queen's in there. She's everybody's mom. Including mine.
room_heat_mom.spoken_text: The queen's in there. She's everybody's mom. Including mine.

room_whatif_smoke_why.caption: Why do we gulp honey when you smoke us? Nobody's sure. One idea: smoke means fire, so we pack a lunch.
room_whatif_smoke_why.spoken_text: Why do we gulp honey when you smoke us? Nobody's sure. One idea: smoke means fire, so we pack a lunch.

room_ask_anything.caption: Got a bee question? Pinch and ask. I've got half a minute and a spreadsheet.
room_ask_anything.spoken_text: Got a bee question? Pinch and ask. I've got half a minute and a spreadsheet.

room_throw_writeup.caption: Who threw that? I'm writing it up.
room_throw_writeup.spoken_text: Who threw that? I'm writing it up.
